description: This bar chart, from the paper "Knowing You Don't Know: Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round RAG through Self-Practicing," compares the performance of two models, Flan-T5-783M (blue bars) and a baseline model (red bars), across three different datasets—TriviaQA, HotPotQA, and 2Wiki—in two evaluation metrics: EM (Exact Match) and F1. The horizontal axis lists the six evaluation scenarios: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). The vertical axis represents performance scores, ranging from 25 to 85, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each dataset and metric, there are two adjacent bars: the blue bar for Flan-T5-783M and the red bar for the baseline. The chart shows that Flan-T5-783M consistently outperforms the baseline across all scenarios. Specifically, for TriviaQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M scores 77.3 while the baseline scores 77.1; for TriviaQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M scores 82.8 and the baseline scores 83.8; for HotPotQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M scores 37.0 and the baseline scores 31.9; for HotPotQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M scores 49.7 and the baseline scores 43.3; for 2Wiki (EM), Flan-T5-783M scores 44.5 and the baseline scores 32.5; and for 2Wiki (F1), Flan-T5-783M scores 53.3 and the baseline scores 38.1. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the datasets listed on the x-axis.
